CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "actorId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "entityType" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_sessions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "tokenHash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."deposits" (
  "amountBaseUnits" int8 NOT NULL,
  "blockchainSlot" int8,
  "confirmations" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "detectedAt" timestamptz,
  "escrowId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "receiverWallet" character varying(64),
  "senderWallet" character varying(64),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "txSignature" character varying(128),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "deposits_status_check_ed455a84" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'detected', 'confirmed', 'failed', 'expired'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."disputes" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "milestoneId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "openedById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "resolution" text,
  "resolutionNote" text,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "resolvedById" uuid,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "disputes_resolution_check_941ded77" CHECK ("resolution" IN ('release_to_freelancer', 'refund_to_client')),
  CONSTRAINT "disputes_status_check_19ab4f36" CHECK ("status" IN ('open', 'under_review', 'resolved', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."escrows" (
  "amountBaseUnits" int8 NOT NULL,
  "asset" text DEFAULT 'usdc' NOT NULL,
  "clientWallet" character varying(64),
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "escrowAddress" character varying(64),
  "freelancerWallet" character varying(64),
  "fundedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "milestoneId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "network" text DEFAULT 'solana' NOT NULL,
  "quoteId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quoteRateBrlPerUsdc" numeric(18,8) NOT NULL,
  "refundedAt" timestamptz,
  "releasedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'created' NOT NULL,
  "tokenDecimals" int2 DEFAULT 6 NOT NULL,
  "tokenMint" character varying(64),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "escrows_asset_check_151aaf2a" CHECK ("asset" IN ('usdc')),
  CONSTRAINT "escrows_network_check_ab834eea" CHECK ("network" IN ('solana')),
  CONSTRAINT "escrows_status_check_7058a81b" CHECK ("status" IN ('created', 'funding_pending', 'funded', 'release_pending', 'released', 'refund_pending', 'refunded', 'failed', 'expired'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ledger_entries" (
  "account" text NOT NULL,
  "amountBaseUnits" int8 NOT NULL,
  "asset" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "direction" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "transactionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ledger_entries_account_check_139c9b2e" CHECK ("account" IN ('client_funds', 'escrow_holding', 'freelancer_payable', 'pix_clearing', 'crypto_clearing', 'platform_revenue', 'system_suspense')),
  CONSTRAINT "ledger_entries_asset_check_9ae68c30" CHECK ("asset" IN ('brl', 'usdc')),
  CONSTRAINT "ledger_entries_direction_check_6cfe4aa1" CHECK ("direction" IN ('debit', 'credit'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ledger_transactions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "escrowId" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" character varying(128) NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ledger_transactions_type_check_7a2bdeec" CHECK ("type" IN ('escrow_funded', 'escrow_released', 'escrow_refunded', 'pix_payout', 'platform_fee', 'adjustment'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."milestones" (
  "amountBrlCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "releasedAt" timestamptz,
  "sequence" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamptz,
  "title" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "milestones_status_check_4efd7878" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'awaiting_funds', 'funded', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'approved', 'release_pending', 'released', 'disputed', 'refund_pending', 'refunded', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payouts" (
  "amountBrlCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "escrowId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "externalId" character varying(191),
  "failureReason" character varying(500),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" character varying(128) NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "pixKey" character varying(140) NOT NULL,
  "provider" text DEFAULT 'mock_pix' NOT NULL,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payouts_provider_check_7cf83e86" CHECK ("provider" IN ('mock_pix')),
  CONSTRAINT "payouts_status_check_92bc5f55" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'processing', 'paid', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."projects" (
  "agreedTotalBrlCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "clientId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "freelancerId" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "projects_status_check_c5ca4f72" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quotes" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "amountBaseUnits" int8 NOT NULL,
  "amountBrlCents" int8 NOT NULL,
  "asset" text DEFAULT 'usdc' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "milestoneId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "rateBrlPerUsdc" numeric(18,8) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "quotes_asset_check_151aaf2a" CHECK ("asset" IN ('usdc')),
  CONSTRAINT "quotes_status_check_9905e461" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'accepted', 'expired', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refunds" (
  "amountBaseUnits" int8 NOT NULL,
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "escrowId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "failureReason" character varying(500),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "requestedById" uuid,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'requested' NOT NULL,
  "txSignature" character varying(128),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "refunds_status_check_104742b8" CHECK ("status" IN ('requested', 'processing', 'confirmed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."releases" (
  "amountBaseUnits" int8 NOT NULL,
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "escrowId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "failureReason" character varying(500),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "requestedById" uuid,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'requested' NOT NULL,
  "txSignature" character varying(128),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "releases_status_check_104742b8" CHECK ("status" IN ('requested', 'processing', 'confirmed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_5b6d1a59" CHECK ("role" IN ('user', 'admin'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."webhook_events" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "eventType" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "externalId" character varying(191) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastError" text,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "signature" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "webhook_events_provider_check_fbd2b4da" CHECK ("provider" IN ('mock_pix', 'solana')),
  CONSTRAINT "webhook_events_status_check_3aef280c" CHECK ("status" IN ('received', 'processing', 'processed', 'failed', 'ignored'))
)
